content:
clare: quick FYI before Thursday onboarding: noticed the runtime-config KB example uses the old sample host and one internal anchor is stale. small PR would fix both. page: https://kb.internal.redwood/runtime-config
ezra: can you paste the snippet and the broken anchor so i can confirm?
clare: snippet as rendered now:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.legacy/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","prompt":"hi"}'
```
broken anchor: links to `#kv-cache-2x` but header is `KV cache (v3)` so the in-page link 404s to the section.
lee: i can own this. small PR: update host to `api.redwood-inference.com`, fix anchor to `#kv-cache-v3`, add a changelog line and a one-line QA step. assign to me.
clare: assigning to @lee. can you also add a note to the onboarding quickstart repo so new hires don't copy the old host?
lee: good catch. i'll put the note in the docs PR and open an issue in onboarding-scripts. ETA ~1h.
opsbot: Reminder: docs changes to runtime-config must pass the staging render check. Please include a staging preview link in PR description.
pr-bot: PR draft created: branch `docs/patch/runtime-host-anchor-180888` by lee, target `main`. URL: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/900 (auto-note)
ezra: once PR is up can someone run the staging render and ping me; i can eyeball the quickstart callouts.
lee: will do. creating onboarding issue now and linking it in the PR.
clare: awesome 44d. if you want i can merge after your QA step, just ping in this thread with the staging preview.
